# AgentKit operating manual (for the supervising AI)

<!-- GENERATED by `agentkit manual --format md > docs/agent-manual.md` from the CLI definitions (agentkit/cli.py, agentkit/manual.py) and the error registry. Do not edit by hand; tests fail on drift. -->

AgentKit: token-frugal coding tools for AI agents + optional cheap worker with independent verification. Every command prints ONE JSON line {ok,data,error{what,why,next,code,run},truncated,next}.

Global options: --budget N (output tokens, default 2000), --human (text), --root DIR; anywhere on the line.

JSON form: `agentkit manual` (overview, ~1693 tokens), `agentkit manual <command>` (one command), `agentkit manual --all` (everything, ~3766 tokens).

## Quick start (supervisor)

1. `agentkit doctor` — healthy:true? mode direct|dispatch; each failed check has fix
2. `agentkit memory brief; agentkit repo_map` — orient (≤500 + paged tokens)
3. `agentkit model add NAME --base-url URL --model ID --key-env VAR` — once, only for delegate mode; then model test NAME
4. `agentkit task create 'GOAL' --check 'pytest -q' --budget-tokens N` — -> id
5. `agentkit task wait ID --timeout 600` — finished -> ≤300-token report inline
6. review report: pass -> git diff HEAD...agentkit/ID, then git merge agentkit/ID yourself; needs_review -> inspect suspicious flags + diff; fail/invalid -> read checks[].why
7. paused/interrupted/stopped -> agentkit task resume ID [--budget-tokens N]; stop -> agentkit task cancel ID; done with it -> agentkit task clean ID

## Direct vs delegate mode

- **direct**: you read/edit/run with the tools, no model needed; every byte you read costs YOUR (expensive) tokens. Choose for small/precise edits, hard reasoning, no model configured, or workers keep failing.
- **delegate**: task create: a cheap/free worker spends its own tokens in an isolated worktree; you pay ~200-600 (create + wait + ≤300-token report). Choose for clear goals with a test check, multi-file or exploratory work. Measured: worker 42k-70k vs supervisor 181-235 tokens per real multi-file task.
- **hybrid**: hard part direct, rest delegated; trust the verifier's verdict, never the worker's claim.

## Budget and safety rules

- keys: only the env var NAME is stored (--key-env); values are redacted everywhere and never printed; never pass a key as an argument
- feedback only drafts (posted:false); ask your human before filing; no secrets/private code
- uninstall is a dry run unless --yes; show the plan to your human first; never touches source or git history
- workers cannot commit/push; you merge agentkit/<id>; run/verify refuse git push/commit, sudo, rm -rf /|~, curl|sh, .env/~/.ssh
- edit/create/delete/rename/patch are checkpointed: checkpoint rollback ID
- money: task create --budget-tokens/--budget-usd/--budget-minutes (stops <5 s); usd needs --price-in/--price-out; ':free' ids cost 0
- output fits --budget N tokens (default 2000); truncated:true -> run next

## Recovering from common errors

| code | cause | fix |
|---|---|---|
| `AK-MODEL-NONE` | no worker model configured (direct mode) | use the tools directly, or agentkit model add |
| `AK-MODEL-KEYENV` | the model's key environment variable is not set | export the variable named by key_env |
| `AK-MODEL-AUTH` | model rejected the key (401/403) | agentkit model test NAME; check the key |
| `AK-MODEL-429` | model rate limit / quota exhausted (429) | wait for Retry-After or the quota reset, then re-submit |
| `AK-TASK-NOGIT` | dispatch needs a git repo with at least one commit | git init && git add -A && git commit -m init |
| `AK-VERIFY-NOCHECK` | verify/task has no check command | pass --check "<test command>" |
| `AK-VERIFY-INVALID` | a check command is missing or broken | fix the check command itself, not the code |
| `AK-VERIFY-SUSPICIOUS` | checks passed but suspicious changes were found | inspect the diff on the task branch before merging |
| `AK-BUDGET` | task stopped: token / USD / time budget exceeded | raise --budget-* or simplify the task |
| `AK-WORKER-STUCK` | worker made no progress (no new diff / same error repeated) | narrow the goal or use a stronger model |
| `AK-TASK-INTERRUPTED` | worker process died (crash / kill / reboot) | agentkit task report ID; re-submit to retry |
| `AK-TOOL-EDIT-NOMATCH` | old text not found (0 matches) | read the file again; candidates are in data.candidates |
| `AK-TOOL-EDIT-STALE` | file changed since it was last read | read the file again, then edit |
| `AK-RUN-DENIED` | command refused by a permission rule (M-22) | ask the human, or allow it in .agentkit/config.toml [run] |
| `AK-INTERNAL` | bug in agentkit (uncaught exception) | agentkit debug-bundle RUN and attach it to an issue |

Every command can also fail with `AK-USAGE`, `AK-CONFIG`, `AK-INTERNAL`. Full registry: docs/errors.md.

## Output compression

C-08: run and check output is filtered per command (data.filtered{filter,lines,raw}); lines with error/fail/assert/traceback are never dropped. Unfiltered (redacted) text: agentkit logs RUN --raw (RUN = filtered.raw or a check's log), or run --raw. Worker context: repeated results become same_as_turn, old results age to one-line summaries. Tune/disable in .agentkit/config.toml [compress].

## Side-effect legend

- `ro`: read-only (may write .agentkit/ logs)
- `repo`: changes repo files; checkpointed first (undo: checkpoint rollback)
- `state`: writes .agentkit/ state or config only
- `exec`: executes shell commands (permission rules apply)
- `tokens`: calls a model: spends tokens / USD
- `destructive`: deletes data that has no checkpoint
- `net`: network access

### `agentkit read`

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | str |  |  |
| `--allow-secret-file` | bool |  |  |

- **Output `data`:** `path,lines[a,b],total_lines,sha,content('N|text')`
- **Errors:** `AK-PATH` (path missing, outside the repo, a directory, or protected), `AK-READ-BINARY` (file is binary), `AK-READ-SECRET` (refused to read a secret file (.env, ~/.ssh ...)), `AK-READ-SPEC` (bad read spec or range)
- **Side effects:** ro
- **Example:** `agentkit read src/app.py:40-80`

### `agentkit edit`

replace a unique snippet

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | str |  |  |
| `--old` | str |  | exact text to replace (must match once unless --all) |
| `--new` | str |  | replacement text |
| `--old-file` | str |  | read --old from this file |
| `--new-file` | str |  | read --new from this file |
| `--stdin` | bool |  | read {"old":..,"new":..} JSON from stdin |

| `--dry-run` | bool |  |  |
| `--no-syntax-check` | bool |  |  |

- **Output `data`:** `checkpoint,files[{path,action,sha}],undo | dry_run,would_change`
- **Errors:** `AK-PATH` (path missing, outside the repo, a directory, or protected), `AK-TOOL-EDIT-NOMATCH` (old text not found (0 matches)), `AK-TOOL-EDIT-MULTI` (old text matches more than once), `AK-TOOL-EDIT-SYNTAX` (the edit would introduce a syntax error), `AK-TOOL-EDIT-STALE` (file changed since it was last read), `AK-TOOL-EDIT-OP` (bad edit/patch operation (exists, not found, bad JSON, unknown op)), `AK-TOOL-WRITE` (writing files failed; everything was restored)
- **Side effects:** repo
- **Example:** `agentkit edit calc.py --old 'a - b' --new 'a + b'`

### `agentkit model add`

register an OpenAI-compatible worker model (stores the key's env var NAME only); --preset nvidia|gemini|openrouter|agnes|amd-cn fills base URL, key var, pacing

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str |  |  |
| `--preset` | str |  | provider defaults: nvidia \| gemini \| openrouter \| agnes \| amd-cn (explicit flags win) |
| `--base-url` | str |  | OpenAI-compatible base URL (required unless --preset) |
| `--model` | str |  | provider model id (default: NAME) |
| `--key-env` | str |  | NAME of the env var holding the key (never the key itself) |
| `--context` | int |  | context window, tokens (default 32000 or preset) |
| `--rpm` | float |  | max requests per minute this worker sends (free-tier pacing) |
| `--rate-wait` | float |  | seconds to sit out a 429 that has no Retry-After, once per call (0 = pause the task at once) |
| `--max-wait` | float |  | longest Retry-After (s) to sit out before pausing (default 30) |
| `--max-tokens` | int |  | max_tokens per call (reasoning models need room) |
| `--price-in` | float | `0.0` | USD per 1M input tokens |
| `--price-out` | float | `0.0` | USD per 1M output tokens |
| `--tier` | str | `low` | low\|mid\|high |
| `--default` | bool |  |  |

- **Output `data`:** `added,config,key_env_set,preset?,warning?`
- **Errors:** `AK-USAGE` (bad command line arguments)
- **Side effects:** state
- **Example:** `agentkit model add nim --preset nvidia --model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b`

- **Output `data`:** `id,status,deduped?,warnings? (next: task wait)`

- **Side effects:** tokens, net, exec, state

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | str |  | zero or more |
| `--all` | bool |  | every finished task |
| `--keep-branch` | bool |  | keep agentkit/<id> branches |

- **Output `data`:** `cleaned,branches_kept`
- **Errors:** `AK-TASK-UNKNOWN` (unknown or invalid task id), `AK-TASK-STATE` (operation not allowed in the task's current state), `AK-GIT` (a git command failed)
- **Side effects:** destructive
- **Example:** `agentkit task clean --all --keep-branch`

### `agentkit logs`

structured event log of a run/task (where it failed); --raw: unfiltered run output

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str |  |  |
| `--errors` | bool |  | only events with an error code |
| `--tail` | int |  | last N events |
| `--raw` | bool |  | raw (redacted) stdout/stderr of a run log id (run-...) |

- **Output `data`:** `id,events,shown,format,lines,hints{code:fix} | --raw: id,stdout,stderr,logs`
- **Errors:** `AK-LOGS-UNKNOWN` (no events for that run / task id)
- **Side effects:** ro
- **Example:** `agentkit logs t1a2b3c --errors`

### `agentkit debug-bundle`

redacted .tar.gz of config (no keys), events, report for a bug report

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str |  |  |
| `--with-transcript` | bool |  | include the worker transcript (may contain code) |

- **Output `data`:** `bundle,bytes,files,error_codes,note (next: feedback --bug)`
- **Errors:** `AK-LOGS-UNKNOWN` (no events for that run / task id)
- **Side effects:** state
- **Example:** `agentkit debug-bundle t1a2b3c`

### `agentkit feedback`

draft a GitHub issue (never posts): --bug RUN_ID | --idea TEXT

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bug` | str |  | one of --bug / --idea; run or task id of the failure |
| `--idea` | str |  | one of --bug / --idea; feature request text |

- **Output `data`:** `posted(false),title,url,search_first,body,rules`
- **Errors:** `AK-LOGS-UNKNOWN` (no events for that run / task id)
- **Side effects:** ro
- **Example:** `agentkit feedback --idea 'task wait --json-lines'`

### `agentkit uninstall`

remove package, user config/data, .agentkit/ + worktrees; dry run unless --yes

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | bool |  | really delete (default: print the plan only) |
| `--this-repo` | bool |  | only this repo's .agentkit/ and worktrees; keep package + user config |
| `--keep-package` | bool |  | do not pip uninstall the package |
| `--delete-branches` | bool |  | also delete agentkit/<task> branches |

- **Output `data`:** `plan: repos,user_paths,package,dry_run,hint (next: --yes) | uninstalled,repos,user_paths_removed`
- **Errors:** `AK-TASK-STATE` (operation not allowed in the task's current state)
- **Side effects:** destructive
- **Example:** `agentkit uninstall --this-repo`

### `agentkit manual`

this manual: overview | <command> detail | --all

| arg | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `words` | str |  | zero or more; a command or group, e.g. task create |
| `--all` | bool |  | every command in full (≈4k tokens; may need --budget) |
| `--format` | str | `json` | md prints Markdown text (docs/agent-manual.md) |

- **Output `data`:** `overview | commands{path:detail}`
- **Errors:** only the common ones
- **Side effects:** ro
- **Example:** `agentkit manual task create`
